name: quick-pr
description: Create GitHub PRs quickly from VS Code using worktree workflow

quick-pr.ai.enabled.description: Enable AI generation for PR title and body

quick-pr.ai.baseUrl.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1)

quick-pr.ai.model.description: Model name for OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, deepseek-v4-flash)

quick-pr.ai.promptTemplate.default: Generate a professional GitHub pull request title and description based on the following commit information. Return your response as JSON with "title" and "body" fields.
quick-pr.ai.promptTemplate.description: System prompt template for AI PR generation

quick-pr.cleanupWorktreeAfterPr.description: Whether to delete worktree after PR is created
